name: Yuurei-san to no H na Test Benkyou
original_name: 幽霊さんとのHなテスト勉強
source:
Suddenly a ghost of beautiful girl appears.
So let's start studying to get involved with her.
Deep communication in a classroom makes "it" bigger..

This is an adventure game in a style of quiz.
You have to write down the answer on her body.

Multi-ending system has 8 patterns.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088213.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
突然，一个美丽少女的幽灵出现了。
所以让我们开始学习与她交往吧。
课堂上的深入沟通让“它”变得更大。

这是一款问答风格的冒险游戏。
你要把答案写在她的身上。

多结局系统有8种模式。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088213.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
